Deposit $25 of USDC into Nucleus's main product on Arbitrum and keep the position open, the way a real user would. Cost: $25 of capital in the position, plus about $2 of gas in total. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Repeat the core action once at half size in the second week, so the wallet's history on Nucleus is a pattern, not a single visit. Cost: about $2 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.
Keep a weekly cadence for 6 weeks: one small qualifying action a week (a deposit, a swap, a claim or a vote), never a burst in one day. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 5 minutes a week.

Hold the position at least 42 days and across a month-end, when activity snapshots are usually taken; do not withdraw the week a launch is rumoured. Cost: the $25 stays in the position. Time: 42 days.

Check Nucleus's official announcements once a week for a points, snapshot or claim post, and claim only from a link the protocol itself publishes; never pay a fee to claim. Cost: $0. Time: 5 minutes a week.
Log the wallet, the dates and every transaction hash in a farm diary as you go, so the position can be repeated, proven or unwound later. Cost: $0. Time: 5 minutes.
